name: Helior Bronze Summit
passives: Laurel Supremacy: excellence chains bonuses after clean tactical execution.
lore: Helior Bronze Summit is a colossal Olympian Titan shaped by excellence proves divinity. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Bronze, gold, marble, celestial light, living statue anatomy, ichor-lit cracks, sculptural bodies. The silhouette must be colossal, non-human, readable on mobile, and unmistakably Olympian.
developmentStatus: Playable data scaffold complete; artwork pending.
